text:
alex: CI red on PR #6128 — publish-image step failed when pushing the built image to our internal registry. Not sure if it's CI or the registry. Anyone able to triage?

ci-bot: Pipeline #6128 (merge-to-main) failed: job publish-image. Logs: https://ci.internal/red/6128 :x: 

maria: on it. can you paste the buildx command and the failing lines from the logs?

alex: here's the relevant snippet:

```
# buildx command used in CI
DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker buildx build --push --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 \
  --tag registry.internal/acme/service:pr-6128 --file Dockerfile .

# log
failed to push layer: unexpected Content-Length (expected=12345 actual=0) while uploading chunk 3/7
error: received status code 502 from registry "registry.internal" - Bad Gateway
registry-response: {"error":"backend read timeout","correlation_id":"abc123"}
```

sam: hmm two things jump out: 1) 502 from registry (bad gateway) and 2) content-length mismatch on a chunk. i've seen buildx + cached layers produce zero-length uploads when cache metadata is corrupt or buildx cache exporter changed format.

maria: also note that last commit touched Dockerfile: switched to multi-stage `COPY --from=builder` with `--chown=` on one layer. that can rewrite layer tarball ordering in some buildkit versions. could be a layer rewrite + registry flake combo.

sam: try rerun with cache disabled to see if it's cache-related: set `BUILDX_NO_CACHE=1` in the job or pass `--no-cache` to buildx. also switch to `--progress=plain` to get more verbose output. if it still fails consistently, we'll bisect.

alex: kicked off a rerun now with `BUILDX_NO_CACHE=1` and `--progress=plain`. pinging @infra for registry logs for the timestamp window. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

infra-bot: Registry alert: backend recycle during push window 2024-02-06T15:42:00Z - 2024-02-06T15:47:00Z. Elevated 502 rate observed. Correlation id abc123. S3 read timeout spike noted.

sam: that correlation id matches alex's push attempt. sounds like a transient registry backend issue. if rerun passes, we can mark as infra flake. if it fails again even with no-cache, we'll open a bisect for the Dockerfile/buildx changes.

alex: rerun finished: SUCCESS — image pushed and manifest available. marking this as transient infra flake for now. will keep an eye and reopen if it recurs. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks — i'll add a short note on PR saying: pin buildx version in CI and avoid relying on cache format across major buildx bumps. also adding `--no-cache` toggle to the job so we can quickly test cache vs infra flakes later. :thumbsup:
